ItemID: unavailable; Title: Standing in the Breach; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rootsy songwriting appeals to me, but I would choose something more blues-focused today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Gary Clark Jr. Live; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: My recent Clapton and Hendrix listening makes this live blues-guitar album my pick today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Sleepwalk - First Two Stereo Albums ORIGINAL RECORDINGS REMASTERED; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Vintage instrumental recordings are not what I feel like hearing right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Boats, Beaches, Bars & Ballads; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The laid-back beach-song mood feels less relevant than blues and roots rock today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: The Soul Sessions, Vol. 2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Soulful vocals fit some of my listening, but this would not be my first choice today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Different Shades Of Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent interests, though I would try Gary Clark Jr. first.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Man Against Machine; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: My interest in Blown Away gives this country album some appeal, but I am leaning toward blues today.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country and roots direction sounds appealing, but I am only choosing one album this visit.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Led Zeppelin IV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues-influenced rock suits my taste, but I would rather explore the live Gary Clark Jr. album now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: All Your Favorite Bands; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The roots-rock songwriting could suit my interest in You Should Be So Lucky, but I would leave it for another visit.
